scope: design/overview-intake at a4573b5 plus uncommitted kit; not latest origin/main. See docs/testing/BRANCH-DIAGNOSTICS-2026-10-25.md for upstream implementations.
note: Coverage inventory, not execution results. Partial means prototype/helper evidence only. V5 overrides historical topology and workflow semantics.

stories.title: Network Overview
stories.gap: Six beneficiaries and hub, product quantities, status, search and inspector work on a static fixture. Live inventory/projections and a full site-detail page are not connected.

stories.title: Inventory Adjustment
stories.gap: Disabled navigation only is tested. Need adjustment UI/API/ledger, reasons/timestamps, negative rejection, stale-plan 409 and atomic competing-version tests.

stories.title: Historical Demand Import
stories.gap: Offline revision/gap/leakage validation exists. Need real CSV upload, row/header errors, duplicate policy, provenance, persistence and proof that import never posts stock.

stories.title: Demand Forecast
stories.gap: Static seven-day readout and offline forecast core are tested separately. Need live submit/job/publication/readout with actual model/run metadata and fallback identity.

stories.title: Shortage Alerts
stories.gap: Selected-date warnings and offline lot projection are tested. Need saved live forecast/stock inputs to dated shortage results and API/UI integration.

stories.title: Uncertainty Visibility
stories.gap: No-interval labels and pure central/conservative policies exist. Need real planning-mode interaction, actual quantile provenance and unsupported probability rejection.

stories.title: Generate Transfer Plan
stories.gap: API 404 and disabled controls are tested, not allocation. Need solver and independent checker in both explicit transfer modes, donor/reserve/capacity/FEFO/conservation/cost/status assertions.

stories.title: Inspect Recommendations
stories.gap: Design lab explains an illustrative 80-meal proposal and 40-meal residual. Need saved real plan source/destination, donor effect, assumptions and simulated review with no dispatch or stock change.

stories.title: Compare Scenarios
stories.gap: Disabled scenario view and pure frozen forecast handoff only. Need immutable operational scenario, validated changes/new ID, paired rerun, before/after and replay after source mutations.

stories.title: Handle Impossible Plans
stories.gap: Illustrative residual unmet and native status gates only. Need real scarcity/partial feasibility, contradictory constraints, UNKNOWN/MODEL_INVALID, one-method failure and independent no-invented-stock checks.

stories.title: Reproducible Demo
stories.gap: Reload repeats only the static fixture. Need authorized demo-only database reset, audit, stock/history restoration, complete shortage-to-plan flow and five rehearsals.

stories.title: Model Transparency
stories.gap: Simulated labels, absent intervals, hub semantics and offline provenance/evaluation exist. Need visible saved actual-provider/checkpoint/run/fallback/evaluation metadata.

stories.title: Paired conventional and EGP-PI comparison
stories.gap: Need both real methods on identical frozen inputs, both modes, simultaneous allocations, conserved category units and highlighted differences. Research gate remains required.

stories.title: Vulnerability evidence and normalization
stories.gap: Need inspectable attribute sources, simulated/observed classification, normalized weights, score decomposition and policy version.

stories.title: Tune deprivation thresholds and equity weight
stories.gap: Need validated AP/RP/weight inputs, new scenario, real recalculation, objective decomposition and explained changes.

stories.title: Demonstrate research-derived allocation difference
stories.gap: Need a hand-verified AP/RP-active fixture, feasible changed allocation, objective/benchmark metrics and honest computational failure reporting.
